solutionSql:
SELECT d.id, d.name, s.name AS supervisor_name
FROM drivers AS d
LEFT JOIN drivers AS s ON s.id = d.supervisor_id
ORDER BY d.id;
notes: Nera Vale is the only driver with a NULL supervisor, so supervisor_name is NULL only for id 1.
